packageRules.description: Pins with in-catalog constraints: bump only via a deliberate manual change.
The Compose alpha BOM tracks its own prerelease train; group its updates alone.
From v6 the caching in gradle/actions is a proprietary component under Gradle's terms of use; stay on v5 (MIT).
The JDK moves only together with the daemon JVM, compileOptions and detekt (which cannot run on 25+), see CONTRIBUTING.
